# External measured datasets

Raw measured data are stored separately and are never overwritten or silently bundled into releases.

## EnergyDetective 2020 v2

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6590976
- Official Zenodo license: CC BY 4.0
- Raw SHA-256: `ae43c6fb205fb9442ab7ac8da7156afdf91767e06ed4a3252a2fa94c662c2fde`
- Use: hourly HVAC electricity benchmark across 20 Shanghai office buildings, 2015 to 2017.
- Expected extraction target: `datasets/external/energy_detective_2020_v2/`

## D2EPC CERTH SmartHouse

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8420122
- Raw SHA-256: `d8587feb297bf79ef4cea4bb1f597ccbb22b8cdf062f07f4dc87e9a936a2b98b`
- Use here: sensor coverage and quality audit only.
- Limitation: device semantics, time alignment, and anomalous unit labels require further curation.

Review current source-record terms before redistribution.
